001: Regarding the booth layout plan for this industry trade show, where do you think we still need to make adjustments?
I think the product display area near the entrance could be made more prominent to attract more attention.
That makes sense. Let's put our flagship products in the most visible spot.
Okay, I'll contact the design company right away to revise the plan and aim to finalize it tomorrow.
Thanks for your hard work. Remember to send me the revised renderings for confirmation.
No problem. I'll send them to your email by three in the afternoon.
002: I heard the number of buyers at this trade show is much higher than last year. Is that true?
Yes, the organizers said the number of pre-registered visitors has already exceeded last year's total.
That's great. Do we have enough promotional materials prepared?
I'm worried it might not be enough, so I've already asked the printing company to print five thousand extra copies.
Good job. Also, let's prepare some English versions of the materials for overseas clients.
Understood. I'll arrange that right away and make sure everything is in place before the show.
003: Regarding our reception process during the trade show, do you think it's arranged reasonably?
Overall it's good, but the VIP reception part could be more detailed.
How do you think we should improve it specifically?
We could set up a dedicated VIP lounge and provide one-on-one guided tours.
That's a great suggestion. Let's implement it as you proposed.
Alright, I'll draft a detailed reception plan as soon as possible for your review.
004: We're exhibiting tomorrow. Have all the products been confirmed and packed?
Most of them are packed. Two prototype machines are still undergoing final testing.
After the testing is done, make sure to check everything carefully to ensure nothing goes wrong.
Don't worry. I'll personally oversee it, and I've already scheduled a time with the shipping company.
Good. Once we arrive at the venue, check the products for any damage first.
Understood. I'll take photos for the record right away and report any issues immediately.
005: How many important clients have we invited to visit this trade show?
Five have confirmed so far, and two of them are major clients we're working with for the first time.
How are their travel arrangements coming along?
We've already assigned dedicated staff to coordinate with them, and their flights and hotels are booked.
Great. Remember to greet them at our booth in advance when they arrive.
Alright. I'll double-check all the reception details to make sure nothing goes wrong.
006: For the interactive activities at the trade show, which format do you think would be more effective?
I think a product experience combined with an on-site lucky draw would be more appealing.
Roughly how much budget would we need for the lucky draw prizes?
Based on my initial estimate, it would be around twenty thousand yuan.
That budget is acceptable. Write up the specific plan as soon as possible.
Okay. I'll submit the detailed event proposal before the end of the workday today.
007: How do you plan to organize the business cards we collect at the trade show?
I plan to categorize them by industry and level of interest, then enter them into the customer management system.
That's a good approach. Remember to mark the follow-up priority for each client.
Understood. I'll finish all the organizing work within three days after the show ends.
Thanks for your hard work. Give me a summary report first once you're done.
Alright. I'll list the key clients' information separately for your reference.
008: I heard our competitors also launched a similar new product this time. What do you think?
That's true. Their product might have an advantage in terms of pricing.
So how should we respond to this competitive pressure?
I think we should highlight our product's technological advantages and after-sales service.
That makes sense. Have the sales team emphasize those two points during their presentations.
Okay. I'll put together a targeted sales script and send it to the team.
009: For the teardown on the last day of the trade show, have all the staffing arrangements been confirmed?
Yes, they're all set. We've divided into a packing team, a transport team, and an on-site cleanup team.
The valuable exhibits must be escorted by dedicated personnel. We can't afford any negligence.
Don't worry. I'll arrange for two colleagues to accompany the shipment the whole way to ensure safety.
Good. After the teardown, remember to restore the venue to its original condition.
Understood. We'll confirm all the handover procedures with the venue staff.
010: After the trade show ends, when do we plan to have the review meeting?
I suggest holding a dedicated meeting on Monday morning, when everyone is available.
That works. Prepare the data and compiled customer feedback materials in advance.
Okay. I'll organize all the data from the trade show into charts.
Also, don't forget to list both the successful experiences and the shortcomings.
Understood. I'll send the complete review report to everyone before the meeting.
